hero.caption:
Photo postcard of the Ocean Forest Hotel in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina.

Full text on the reverse of the postcard:

Ocean Forest Hotel

North Ocean Boulevard, Myrtle Beach, S.C.

One of the finest resort hotels along the Atlantic Coast, the Ocean Forest offers every facility for a complete vacation. Modified American Plan.

"Lusterchrome" Reg. U.S. Pat. Off. Made only by Tichnor Bros., Inc., Boston 15, Mass.

Giant Post Card

3¢ Stamp U.S.A Postage K-3068

Pub. by Coastal Wholesale Co., Myrtle Beach, S.C.
